newsitem.title: DUBAI: Blast kills eight, traps 150 at Iran mine-agency.
newsitem.headline: Blast kills eight, traps 150 at Iran mine-agency.

text.p: An explosion at a coal mine in northern Iran has killed eight people and trapped another 150 underground, the official news agency IRNA reported on Monday.

IRNA, monitored by the British Broadcasting Corporation, said the explosion on Sunday also injured 31 people. It quoted an official in Gilan province as saying the blast was caused by an electrical short circuit in a mining tunnel at the "Sangrud-e Lowshan" colliery.
It quoted witnesses as saying the explosion trapped around 150 miners in the tunnel.
It did not give other details nor was it immediately clear if the men had been rescued yet.
